findings.issue: Resume could treat outputs from changed configuration or inputs as complete
findings.fix: Before real execution persist run identity covering config, source tree, trajectory and topology/flow hashes; reject mismatches and unrecorded legacy result directories

findings.issue: Concurrent tasks could write the same result directory
findings.fix: Nonblocking exclusive directory lock, released on success or exception

findings.issue: Completion check did not verify formula, offsets and run configuration agree across artifacts
findings.fix: Check those fields alongside metrics and executable policy export

findings.issue: Independent search seeds in a sequential matrix could resolve to the same result path
findings.fix: Reject colliding entries before search; use separate result directories

findings.issue: Accepted teacher_data manifest alias was not supported in resume path calculation
findings.fix: Resolve both supported field names identically

limitations: No real paid-provider calls or broad performance claims.
The new identity guard deliberately refuses legacy outputs without identity metadata; preserve those results and start a new output directory.
Input identity binds paths as well as hashes; relocated experimental outputs may require a fresh output directory.
Finite testing cannot prove absence of all software bugs or universal traffic safety.
